site_surface.short_summary: Bant is a White-centered Bant shard supported-champion order: public honor, sigil-ranked worth, and refined communal protection matter only when they remain tied to Bant institutions and Alara shard context.
site_surface.one_sentence_identity: Bant asks whether greatness can remain worthy when it carries the hopes, order, and support of the whole.
site_surface.tagline: The many raise the worthy line.
content_warnings_or_sensitivity_notes: Bant material can involve hierarchy, rigid social order, war, invasion, and source-bound references to post-Conflux or Phyrexian-era conflict.

core_identity.summary: Bant is the Alara shard identity of White-centered Bant shard public excellence: a living community recognizes a champion, binds that excellence to sigils and sacred order, and rejects collapse into generic harmony, mere procedure, unchecked growth, or perfected control.
core_identity.philosophy: Bant does not simply mean peace, creatures, angels, knights, or value. Its distinctive pressure is whether excellence remains visible, honorable, and accountable to the community that elevates it.
core_identity.central_tension: Bant's harmony can become rigid or insular when the order cannot hear dissent, absorb disruption, or correct itself after contact with values it was not built around.

structure.summary: Bant structure is bounded to five-nation geography, sigil recognition, sacred authority, and champion-order place evidence; exact nation-character descriptions and auxiliary story examples are not used as semantic proof.
confirmed_elements: Rafiq as iconic decorated knight and later Knight-General reference
Valeron and Akrasa as confirmed Bant nations
Jhess as confirmed Bant eastern island/coastal nation
Topa and Eos as confirmed Bant Inner Three nations alongside Akrasa
The Great Conduit as a bounded symbolic and geographic anchor
bounded_elements: Asha as supreme guardian, sacred authority, and presider; angel creation belongs to a council of archmages, not to Asha as founder
Elspeth as having a confirmed Bant knightly and spiritual arc, not governing Bant

great_tension.summary: Bant's ideal order is beautiful because the whole can elevate the worthy champion without dissolving into private appetite. Its risk is that the same system can harden into insularity, rank fixation, or control when dissent and correction are absent.
great_tension.placement_relevance: Use this tension to separate Bant from generic peaceful three-color value, Azorius prison, Selesnya belonging, Simic growth engines, and Naya big-creature immediacy.

views_on_other_factions.stance: Shares community and protection language, but Bant requires Blue refinement, sigil-ranked excellence, and a supported champion rather than go-wide belonging alone.
Shares growth and improvement language, but Bant requires White public order and communal accountability instead of adaptation or research alone.
Shares procedure and refinement, but Bant requires Green living community and champion support rather than rule systems or prison logic alone.
Growth, nature, and creature scale are insufficient without Bant public honor, refinement, and Bant shard champion order.
Protection, peace, and order are insufficient without Blue refinement and Green living community in a Bant shard frame.
Knowledge, perfection, and planning are insufficient without White public trust and Green community support.
Naya creature force and primal scale are not Bant unless the prompt centers refined public honor and a supported champion.
Esper perfection-control and artifact order are not Bant when community life and public champion accountability are absent.
Temur instinct and wild endurance are not Bant without White-centered public order and sigil recognition.
Abzan hierarchy and clan endurance are not Bant when excellence is inherited or duty-bound rather than publicly recognized as champion service.
Jeskai discipline and wisdom are not Bant without the Bant shard living community and supported-champion frame.
Grixis extraction and private advantage oppose Bant public accountability and community-elevated excellence.
Jund predatory force opposes Bant honor-bound recognition even when both can involve combat or creatures.
Sultai exploitation and status control are not Bant hierarchy; Bant proof needs public trust and champion service.
Five-color good-stuff is not Bant unless the prompt actually centers Bant shard evidence and Bant shard champion order.
Efficient value, creatures, or broad flexibility do not prove Bant without Bant-specific honor, sigil, or shard anchors.
Balance, harmony, cooperation, and peace remain generic until tied to Bant public champion order.
Angels, knights, beasts, exalted, shard aesthetics, or phrases such as the best of White, Blue, and Green are not enough by themselves.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: Rafiq is the clearest Bant champion expression: one worthy attacker receives the force and recognition of the whole.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The player wants broad go-wide tokens, prison control, or ramp with no champion frame.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Build around a single protected attacker and amplify combat through support, auras, equipment, and exalted-style pressure.
caution_notes: Card data and deck guidance require live verification before runtime Commander Compass use.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: Manual-fill guidance places creature-forward value and clean creature-based combo inside Bant when the line remains creature/community framed.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The deck becomes generic combo efficiency with no communal or creature-forward identity.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Chain creatures for resource growth, card flow, and value loops while keeping the engine board-centered.
caution_notes: Commander-specific claims are curation support, not live recommendation output.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: The workbook and manual-fill notes support enchantress and aura engines as Bant-facing when they stay creature-centered instead of prison-centered.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The enchantment package is primarily tax, denial, or prison without a creature/community frame.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Turn enchantments into steady growth and card flow while building a protected threat.
caution_notes: Use as lane support only until Commander Compass promotion.

native_fit_commanders.why_this_fits: The Commander workbook identifies Deep Clue Sea as a Bant value and Clue-token expression with White structure, Blue card draw, and Green support.
native_fit_commanders.skip_if: The player wants fast combat or non-Bant artifact control rather than incremental Clue value.
native_fit_commanders.gameplay_summary: Generate and spend Clues for card advantage and decision-rich resource growth.
caution_notes: Workbook curation is not yet runtime recommendation data.

weird_stretch_commanders.why_this_fits: Evasive tempo and creature-based tap/untap value can remain Bant-facing.
weird_stretch_commanders.skip_if: The build is hard-lock stax, resource denial, or prison-first control.
weird_stretch_commanders.gameplay_summary: Use combat triggers and untap value as tempo rather than as a table-denial lock.
caution_notes: Derevi must be strategy-qualified before recommendation.

advanced_complexity_commanders.why_this_fits: Manual-fill guidance and workbook rows support blink and ETB value as Bant-facing when creature/community framing stays present.
advanced_complexity_commanders.skip_if: The player dislikes trigger management or slower value engines.
advanced_complexity_commanders.gameplay_summary: Reuse creature enters-the-battlefield effects and protect key board pieces through blink timing.
caution_notes: Runtime complexity lane is not implemented in VM-159.

iconic_lore_forward_commanders.why_this_fits: Jenara is a Bant-associated legendary angel and supports an honor-coded protected-threat lane.
iconic_lore_forward_commanders.skip_if: The user wants broad board consensus or prison control rather than a focused protected threat.
iconic_lore_forward_commanders.gameplay_summary: Grow and protect one evasive threat while the deck supplies support, counters, and defense.
caution_notes: Specific angel hierarchy is not inferred from this card.
